title: Act 7 (Parts 1–2) — The Broken Handshake and the War of Attrition
ledger: When NVIDIA's board forced Jensen Huang out in November 2026 they thought they were avoiding a governance crisis; instead they broke the personal handshake network that held the AI supply chain together and turned the most valuable chip architect on earth into a free agent
Boardroom, forced out, handshake network snapping, free agent

Hiring Jensen to lead TerraFab would not be an overnight miracle: clean room physics, Intel's 14A ramp, IP lawsuits and SpaceX's $44B dependence on NVIDIA's Vera Rubin remain; a Musk-Huang partnership would be a brutal multi-year war of attrition betting up to $119B on a self-contained AI engine from Texas to low-Earth orbit
Four obstacles, war of attrition, $119B stack, Texas to orbit tower
Whether Jensen signs or uses the offer as leverage, NVIDIA's monopoly has lost its biggest moat; the full boardroom story and the $4 trillion standoff are in the linked video
Contract vs leverage, cracked moat, video call to action
